detail.title: CP-UNS-7216DR-V3
features: High-performance stream media transfer and storage capability
Support local storage and IP-SAN storage
Front panel can displays system service status
Real-time live video monitoring with flexible layouts
AI-powered target search and movement analysis
Zone-based access control with remote door                     management
Two-way video intercom with emergency                                 communication

General.System Disk: Seagate 7200 RPM Enterprise Class HDD 6 TB
General.Hard disk hot swap: Support hot swap and online replacement
General.Interface Ports: 2 × USB 2.0 on front panel; 2 × USB 3.0 on rear panel, 4 HDMI ports, 1 VGA port
General.Persons for Door Access Rules: 10,000 (1 password, 2 face images, 3 fingerprints, and 5 cards for each person)
General.Power: Max. power 315 W, Stable power 210 W
General.Devices: Single Server: 2,000 devices; Multiple Servers: 6,000 devices
General.Auto Connect Devices: Single Server: 1,000 devices; Multiple Servers: 5,000 devices
General.Add Devices by ONVIF: Single Server: 500 devices, 1,000 channels; Multiple Servers: 2,500 devices, 5,000 channels
General.Face Recognition Devices and Channels: Single Server: 20 devices, 100 channels; Multiple Servers: 100 devices, 500 channels
General.Devices Accessed via RTSP: Single Server: 500 devices, 1,000 channels; Multiple Servers: 2,500 devices, 5,000 channels
General.Access Control Devices: Single Server: 200 devices; 500 doors; Multiple Servers: 600 devices; 1,500 doors
General.Alarm Controller: Single Server: 64 devices; 640 zones; Multiple Servers: 320 devices; 3,200 zones
General.Emergency Phone Towers: Single Server: 20 devices; 40 channels; Multiple Servers: 100 devices; 200 channels
General.Heat Map Channels: Single Server: 32 channels; Multiple Servers: 160 channels
General.Total Incoming Bandwidth: Single Server: 600 Mbps; Multiple Servers: 3,000 Mbps
General.Incoming Video Bandwidth: Single Server: 600 Mbps; Multiple Servers: 3,000 Mbps
General.Incoming Picture Bandwidth: Single Server: 100 Mbps; Multiple Servers: 500 Mbps
General.Total Outgoing Bandwidth: Single Server: 600 Mbps; Multiple Servers: 3,000 Mbps
General.Outgoing Video Bandwidth: Single Server: 600 Mbps; Multiple Servers: 3,000 Mbps
General.Outgoing Picture Bandwidth: Single Server: 100 Mbps; Multiple Servers: 500 Mbps
General.Total Storage Bandwidth: Single Server: 600 Mbps; Multiple Servers: 3,000 Mbps
General.Video Storage Bandwidth: Single Server: 600 Mbps; Multiple Servers: 3,000 Mbps
General.Prerecording Bandwidth for Alarm Record: Single Server: 400 Mbps; Multiple Servers: 2,000 Mbps
General.Max. Capacity per Storage Server (Local: Single Server: 200 TB; Multiple Servers: 1 PB
General.Storage of Events or Alarms without Pic: Single Server: 240 per sec; Multiple Servers: 480 per sec
General.Access Control Events: Single Server: 240 per sec; Multiple Servers: 480 per sec
General.CPU: Recommended: Intel® Core i7-11700 @2.50 GHz; Minimum: Intel® Core i5-9500 @3.00 GHz
General.Graphics Card: Recommended: NVIDIA® GeForce® RTX 3060; Minimum: Intel® UHD Graphics 630
General.Hard Drive Capacity: Recommended: 200 GB free space for EVMS Pro Client; Minimum: 100 GB free space for  EVMS Pro Client
General.Client Operating System: Microsoft® Windows 10 20H2 Pro (32-bit)                                                                                                        Microsoft® Windows 10 20H2 Pro (64-bit)                                                                                                           Microsoft® Windows 11 21H2 Pro (64-bit)
